function updateFieldStyles() {
    document.querySelectorAll('textarea, select, input[type="text"], input[type="number"]').forEach(field => {
        // Remove existing listeners to avoid duplicates
        field.removeEventListener('input', handleFieldChange);
        field.removeEventListener('change', handleFieldChange);
        // Add the listeners
        field.addEventListener('input', handleFieldChange);
        field.addEventListener('change', handleFieldChange);
    });
    
    // Add multiple event listeners for the engagement field to end the timer
    const engagementField = document.getElementById('thriveEngagement');
    if (engagementField && !engagementField.hasAttribute('data-timer-listener')) {
        // End timer on blur (tab out)
        engagementField.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            checkThriveEnd();
        });
        
        // End timer on input (when user types in the field)
        engagementField.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '' && thriveStartTime && !thriveEndTime) {
                checkThriveEnd();
            }
        });
        
        // End timer when engagement field gets content from checkboxes
        engagementField.addEventListener('change', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '' && thriveStartTime && !thriveEndTime) {
                checkThriveEnd();
            }
        });
        
        engagementField.setAttribute('data-timer-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    // Add specific styling handlers for combo fields that don't use checkboxes
    const vulnerabilityField = document.getElementById('thriveVulnerability');
    const endStatementField = document.getElementById('thriveEndStatementText');
    
    if (vulnerabilityField && !vulnerabilityField.hasAttribute('data-combo-listener')) {
        vulnerabilityField.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '') {
                applyCompletedStyle(this);
            } else {
                applyIncompleteStyle(this);
            }
        });
        vulnerabilityField.setAttribute('data-combo-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    if (endStatementField && !endStatementField.hasAttribute('data-combo-listener')) {
        endStatementField.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '') {
                applyCompletedStyle(this);
            } else {
                applyIncompleteStyle(this);
            }
        });
        endStatementField.setAttribute('data-combo-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    // Add keyboard accessibility to H and E section headers
    const harmSectionHeader = document.getElementById('harmSectionHeader');
    const engagementSectionHeader = document.getElementById('engagementSectionHeader');
    
    if (harmSectionHeader && !harmSectionHeader.hasAttribute('data-keyboard-listener')) {
        harmSectionHeader.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleHarmSection();
            }
        });
        harmSectionHeader.addEventListener('focus', function(e) {
            // Auto-expand when focused via keyboard
            const checkboxes = document.getElementById('thriveHCheckboxes');
            if (checkboxes.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                toggleHarmSection();
            }
        });
        harmSectionHeader.setAttribute('data-keyboard-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    if (engagementSectionHeader && !engagementSectionHeader.hasAttribute('data-keyboard-listener')) {
        engagementSectionHeader.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleEngagementSection();
            }
        });
        engagementSectionHeader.addEventListener('focus', function(e) {
            // Auto-expand when focused via keyboard
            const checkboxes = document.getElementById('thriveEngagementCheckboxes');
            if (checkboxes.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                toggleEngagementSection();
            }
        });
        engagementSectionHeader.setAttribute('data-keyboard-listener', 'true');
    }

    // Add blur event listeners to H and E checkbox containers to auto-collapse when user tabs out
    const harmCheckboxContainer = document.getElementById('thriveHCheckboxes');
    const engagementCheckboxContainer = document.getElementById('thriveEngagementCheckboxes');
    
    if (harmCheckboxContainer && !harmCheckboxContainer.hasAttribute('data-blur-listener')) {
        harmCheckboxContainer.addEventListener('focusout', function(e) {
            // Use a timeout to check if focus moved outside the container
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (!this.contains(document.activeElement) && !this.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    // Auto-collapse the section
                    this.classList.remove('expanded');
                    this.classList.add('collapsed');
                    document.getElementById('harmSectionHeader').classList.remove('expanded');
                    
                    // Update summary
                    const summary = document.getElementById('harmSummary');
                    const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#thriveHCheckboxes .selection-button.selected')).map(btn => btn.getAttribute('data-value'));
                    if (selected.length > 0) {
                        summary.textContent = selected.length === 1 ? selected[0] : `${selected.length} items selected`;
                    } else {
                        summary.textContent = 'Click to expand options';
                    }
                }
            }, 100);
        });
        harmCheckboxContainer.setAttribute('data-blur-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    if (engagementCheckboxContainer && !engagementCheckboxContainer.hasAttribute('data-blur-listener')) {
        engagementCheckboxContainer.addEventListener('focusout', function(e) {
            // Use a timeout to check if focus moved outside the container
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (!this.contains(document.activeElement) && !this.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                    // Auto-collapse the section
                    this.classList.remove('expanded');
                    this.classList.add('collapsed');
                    document.getElementById('engagementSectionHeader').classList.remove('expanded');
                    
                    // Update summary
                    const summary = document.getElementById('engagementSummary');
                    const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#thriveEngagementCheckboxes .selection-button.selected')).map(btn => btn.getAttribute('data-value'));
                    if (selected.length > 0) {
                        summary.textContent = selected.length === 1 ? selected[0] : `${selected.length} items selected`;
                    } else {
                        summary.textContent = 'Click to expand options';
                    }
                }
            }, 100);
        });
        engagementCheckboxContainer.setAttribute('data-blur-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    // Ensure label clicks work properly for H and E sections
    document.querySelectorAll('#thriveHCheckboxes label, #thriveEngagementCheckboxes label').forEach(label => {
        if (!label.hasAttribute('data-click-handler')) {
            label.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                // Ensure the default label behavior works
                const forId = this.getAttribute('for');
                if (forId) {
                    const checkbox = document.getElementById(forId);
                    if (checkbox && checkbox.type === 'checkbox') {
                        // Let the default behavior handle it, but ensure it triggers the onchange
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            if (checkbox.onchange) {
                                checkbox.onchange();
                            }
                        }, 10);
                    }
                }
            });
            label.setAttribute('data-click-handler', 'true');
        }
    });
}

        }

<script>
let thriveStartTime = null;
let thriveEndTime = null;
let carStartTime = null;

function formatTimestamp() {
    return new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
};

// Smart case conversion function
function smartCaseConversion(text) {
    if (!text || text.trim() === '') return text;
    
    // Count uppercase and lowercase letters
    let uppercaseCount = 0;
    let lowercaseCount = 0;
    
    for (let char of text) {
        if (char >= 'A' && char <= 'Z') {
            uppercaseCount++;
        } else if (char >= 'a' && char <= 'z') {
            lowercaseCount++;
        }
    }
    
    // If majority is uppercase, convert all to uppercase
    // If majority is lowercase, convert all to lowercase
    if (uppercaseCount > lowercaseCount) {
        return text.toUpperCase();
    } else if (lowercaseCount > uppercaseCount) {
        return text.toLowerCase();
    }
    
    // If equal or no letters, return as-is
    return text;
}

// Apply smart case conversion to form elements
function applyCaseConversion(element) {
    if (element.value) {
        element.value = smartCaseConversion(element.value);
    }
}

function getThriveStartTime() {
    return thriveStartTime;
}

function getThriveEndTime() {
    return thriveEndTime;
}

function getCarStartTime() {
    return carStartTime;
}

function checkThriveStart() {
    // Only start timing when the first question (THRIVE LEVEL) is answered
    const thriveLevel = document.getElementById('thriveLevel');
    if (!thriveStartTime && thriveLevel.value.trim() !== '') {
        thriveStartTime = formatTimestamp();
    }
}

function checkThriveEnd() {
    // End timing when user tabs out of E (Engagement) field
    // BUT only if the timer has actually started (thriveStartTime exists)
    if (!thriveEndTime && thriveStartTime) {
        thriveEndTime = formatTimestamp();
    }
}

function checkCarStart() {
    if (!carStartTime) {
        carStartTime = formatTimestamp();
    }
}

function applyCompletedStyle(element) {
    // Check if this is a checkbox container - if so, don't override display property
    if (element.classList.contains('checkbox-list')) {
        // For checkbox containers, only add the class and let CSS handle the styling
        element.classList.add('field-completed');
    } else {
        // For regular form fields, apply the styling with important
        element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #2e7d32', 'important');
        element.style.setProperty('background-color', 'rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.15)', 'important');
        element.classList.add('field-completed');
    }
}

function applyIncompleteStyle(element) {
    // Check if this is a checkbox container - if so, don't override display property
    if (element.classList.contains('checkbox-list')) {
        // For checkbox containers, only remove the class and let CSS handle the styling
        element.classList.remove('field-completed');
    } else {
        // For regular form fields, apply the styling with important
        if (element.classList.contains('child-at-risk-select') || element.id === 'thriveLevel' || element.id === 'childAtRisk') {
            element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #d32f2f', 'important');
        } else if (element.tagName === 'SELECT' && !element.classList.contains('child-at-risk-select')) {
            element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #2e7d32', 'important');
        } else {
            element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #d32f2f', 'important');
        }
        element.style.setProperty('background-color', '', 'important');
        element.classList.remove('field-completed');
    }
}

function addComboOption(select, targetTextareaId) {
    if (select.value) {
        const textarea = document.getElementById(targetTextareaId);
        if (textarea.value.trim().length > 0 && !textarea.value.trim().endsWith(',')) {
            textarea.value = textarea.value.trim() + ', ';
        }
        textarea.value += select.value;
        select.value = '';
        textarea.focus();
        
        // Use setTimeout to ensure styling is applied after any other event handlers
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (textarea.value.trim() !== '') {
                applyCompletedStyle(textarea);
            } else {
                applyIncompleteStyle(textarea);
            }
        }, 10);
    }
}

function handleOngoingRiskChange() {
    const ongoingRiskSelect = document.getElementById('childOngoingRisk');
    const ongoingRiskDetails = document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDetails');
    const ongoingRiskDescription = document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDescription');
    
    if (ongoingRiskSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        // Turn the select box red
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.border = '3px solid #d32f2f';
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.2)';
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.color = '#d32f2f';
        
        // Show the additional text field
        ongoingRiskDetails.style.display = 'block';
        ongoingRiskDescription.setAttribute('required', 'true');
        ongoingRiskDescription.setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
    } else {
        // Reset the select box to normal completed style
        if (ongoingRiskSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
            applyCompletedStyle(ongoingRiskSelect);
        } else {
            applyIncompleteStyle(ongoingRiskSelect);
        }
        
        // Hide the additional text field
        ongoingRiskDetails.style.display = 'none';
        ongoingRiskDescription.removeAttribute('required');
        ongoingRiskDescription.setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        ongoingRiskDescription.value = '';
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function showPhilomenaInfo() {
    document.getElementById('philomenaModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function hidePhilomenaInfo() {
    document.getElementById('philomenaModal').style.display = 'none';
}

function handleChildPlanChange() {
    const childPlanSelect = document.getElementById('childPlan');
    const philomenaContainer = document.getElementById('philomenaContainer');
    const philomenaSelect = document.getElementById('philomenaProtocol');
    
    if (childPlanSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        philomenaContainer.style.display = 'block';
        philomenaSelect.setAttribute('required', 'true');
        philomenaSelect.setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
    } else {
        philomenaContainer.style.display = 'none';
        philomenaSelect.removeAttribute('required');
        philomenaSelect.setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        philomenaSelect.value = '';
        document.getElementById('philomenaAdditionalInfo').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').value = '';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').removeAttribute('required');
    }
    
    if (childPlanSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
        applyCompletedStyle(childPlanSelect);
    } else {
        applyIncompleteStyle(childPlanSelect);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function handlePhilomenaChange() {
    const philomenaSelect = document.getElementById('philomenaProtocol');
    const additionalInfo = document.getElementById('philomenaAdditionalInfo');
    
    if (philomenaSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        additionalInfo.style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').setAttribute('required', 'true');
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
    } else {
        additionalInfo.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').removeAttribute('required');
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').value = '';
    }
    
    if (philomenaSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
        applyCompletedStyle(philomenaSelect);
    } else {
        applyIncompleteStyle(philomenaSelect);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

window.onclick = function(event) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('philomenaModal');
    if (event.target == modal) {
        modal.style.display = 'none';

function lockThriveSection() {
    const thriveFields = document.querySelector('.thrive-fields');
    thriveFields.classList.add('locked');
    
    thriveFields.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(field => {
        field.disabled = true;
    });
    
    const thriveCopyBtn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="copyThriveOnly()"]');
    if (thriveCopyBtn) {
        thriveCopyBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
    
    const clearBtn = document.querySelector('.clear-button');
    if (clearBtn) {
        clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
    }
    
    const childAtRiskBtn = document.getElementById('copyChildAtRiskBtn');
    if (childAtRiskBtn && document.getElementById('childAtRisk').value === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'block';
    }
}

function lockChildAtRiskSection() {
    const formContainer = document.querySelector('.form-container');
    formContainer.classList.add('child-at-risk-section-locked');
    
    const childAtRiskSection = document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection');
    childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(field => {
        field.disabled = true;
    });
    
    const childAtRiskBtn = document.getElementById('copyChildAtRiskBtn');
    if (childAtRiskBtn) {
        childAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
    
    const thriveFields = document.querySelector('.thrive-fields');
    if (!thriveFields.classList.contains('locked')) {
        const thriveCopyBtn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="copyThriveOnly()"]');
        if (thriveCopyBtn) {
            thriveCopyBtn.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
}

function lockForm() {
    const thriveFields = document.querySelector('.thrive-fields');
    if (thriveFields) {
        thriveFields.classList.remove('locked');
    }
    
    const formContainer = document.querySelector('.form-container');
    formContainer.classList.add('form-locked');
    
    // Add locked message with animation
    const lockedMessage = document.createElement('div');
    lockedMessage.className = 'locked-message';
    lockedMessage.innerHTML = '⚠️ FORM LOCKED ⚠️<br><span style="font-size: 16px;">All reports have been copied</span>';
    formContainer.appendChild(lockedMessage);
    
    // Make top new report button more prominent
    const topNewReport = document.querySelector('.top-new-report');
    if (topNewReport) {
        topNewReport.classList.add('locked');
    }
    
    document.querySelector('.button-container').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
        if (!btn.classList.contains('new-report-button')) {
            btn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
    
    const newReportBtn = document.getElementById('newReportBtn');
    newReportBtn.style.display = 'block';
    newReportBtn.classList.add('pulse');
    
    const form = document.getElementById('combinedThriveForm');
    form.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(field => {
        field.disabled = true;
    });
}

function startNewReport() {
    if (confirm('Are you sure you want to start a new report? This will clear all current data.')) {
        // Reset timestamp variables
        thriveStartTime = null;
        thriveEndTime = null;
        carStartTime = null;
        window.location.reload();
    }
}

function showCopySuccess(message) {
    const existingSuccess = document.querySelector('.copy-success');
    if (existingSuccess) {
        existingSuccess.remove();
    }
    
    const successDiv = document.createElement('div');
    successDiv.className = 'copy-success';
    successDiv.textContent = message;
    document.body.appendChild(successDiv);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        successDiv.style.animation = 'fadeOut 0.5s ease-out';
        setTimeout(() => {
            successDiv.remove();
        }, 500);
    }, 3000);
}

function clearForm() {
    if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear all form data?')) {
        const form = document.getElementById('combinedThriveForm');
        form.reset();
        resetFormStyles();
        updateProgress();
        // Reset timestamp variables
        thriveStartTime = null;
        thriveEndTime = null;
        carStartTime = null;
        window.location.reload();
    }
}

function updateProgress() {
    const thriveFields = [
        document.getElementById('thriveLevel'),
        document.getElementById('thriveR'),
        document.getElementById('thriveH'),
        document.getElementById('thriveRiskCopy'),
        document.getElementById('thriveInvestigation'),
        document.getElementById('thriveEndStatementText'),
        document.getElementById('thriveVulnerability'),
        document.getElementById('thriveEngagement'),
        document.getElementById('childAtRisk')
    ];
    
    const thriveComplete = thriveFields.every(field => field && field.value.trim() !== '');
    const thriveProgress = document.getElementById('thriveProgress');
    
    if (thriveComplete) {
        thriveProgress.className = 'progress-complete';
        thriveProgress.textContent = '✓ THRIVE section complete';
    } else {
        thriveProgress.className = 'progress-incomplete';
        thriveProgress.textContent = '✗ THRIVE section incomplete';
    }
    
    const childAtRiskValue = document.getElementById('childAtRisk').value;
    const childAtRiskProgress = document.getElementById('childAtRiskProgress');
    
    if (childAtRiskValue === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskProgress.style.display = 'block';
        const childAtRiskSection = document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection');
        const childFields = childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('[required], [data-required="true"]');
        const childComplete = Array.from(childFields).every(field => field.value.trim() !== '');
        
        if (childComplete) {
            childAtRiskProgress.className = 'progress-complete';
            childAtRiskProgress.textContent = '✓ Child at Risk section complete';
        } else {
            childAtRiskProgress.className = 'progress-incomplete';
            childAtRiskProgress.textContent = '✗ Child at Risk section incomplete';
        }
    } else {
        childAtRiskProgress.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function handleChildAtRiskChange() {
    
    const childAtRiskSelect = document.getElementById('childAtRisk');
    const childAtRiskSection = document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection');
    const copyChildAtRiskBtn = document.getElementById('copyChildAtRiskBtn');
    
    if (childAtRiskSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskSection.style.display = 'block';
        copyChildAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'block';
        childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(field => {
            if (field.hasAttribute('required') || field.id === 'philomenaProtocol' || field.id === 'childPlan') {
                field.setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
            }
        });
        // Reset child plan when CAR section is opened
        document.getElementById('childPlan').value = '';
        document.getElementById('philomenaContainer').style.display = 'none';
        // Reset ongoing risk fields
        document.getElementById('childOngoingRisk').value = '';
        document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDetails').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDescription').value = '';
    } else {
        childAtRiskSection.style.display = 'none';
        copyChildAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'none';
        childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(field => {
            field.removeAttribute('required');
            field.setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        });
    }
    
    if (childAtRiskSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
        applyCompletedStyle(childAtRiskSelect);
    } else {
        applyIncompleteStyle(childAtRiskSelect);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function handleSchoolUnknownCheckbox(schoolFieldId, checkboxId) {
    const checkbox = document.getElementById(checkboxId);
    const field = document.getElementById(schoolFieldId);
    
    if (checkbox.checked) {
        field.value = 'Unknown';
        field.removeAttribute('required');
        field.disabled = true;
        applyCompletedStyle(field);
    } else {
        field.value = '';
        field.required = true;
        field.disabled = false;
        applyIncompleteStyle(field);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function handleUnknownCheckbox(childNumber, fieldType) {
    const checkbox = document.getElementById(`child${fieldType}Unknown${childNumber}`);
    const field = document.getElementById(`child${fieldType}${childNumber}`);
    
    if (checkbox.checked) {
        if (fieldType === 'Name') {
            field.value = 'Unknown';
        } else if (fieldType === 'Age') {
            field.value = '';
            field.placeholder = 'Unknown';
        } else if (fieldType === 'Ethnicity') {
            field.value = 'UN Unable to Provide';
        }
        
        field.removeAttribute('required');
        field.disabled = true;
        applyCompletedStyle(field);
    } else {
        if (fieldType === 'Age') {
            field.placeholder = 'Age';
        }
        field.value = '';
        field.required = true;
        field.disabled = false;
        applyIncompleteStyle(field);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function updateChildrenFields() {
    const count = document.getElementById('childrenCount').value;
    const container = document.getElementById('childrenDetailsContainer');
    const inputsContainer = document.getElementById('childrenInputs');
    const schoolContainer = document.getElementById('schoolFieldsContainer');
    
    if (count && count > 0) {
        container.style.display = 'block';
        inputsContainer.innerHTML = '';
        
        for (let i = 1; i <= count; i++) {
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'child-input-group';
            
            // Name field with checkbox
            const nameWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            nameWrapper.className = 'child-field-wrapper name-field';
            
            const nameLabel = document.createElement('label');
            nameLabel.className = 'child-label';
            nameLabel.textContent = `Child ${i} Name:`;
            nameWrapper.appendChild(nameLabel);
            
            const nameFieldContainer = document.createElement('div');
            nameFieldContainer.className = 'field-with-checkbox';
            
            const nameInput = document.createElement('input');
            nameInput.type = 'text';
            nameInput.id = `childName${i}`;
            nameInput.name = `Child ${i} Name`;
            nameInput.placeholder = `Child ${i} Name`;
            nameInput.required = true;
            
            const nameCheckbox = document.createElement('input');
            nameCheckbox.type = 'checkbox';
            nameCheckbox.id = `childNameUnknown${i}`;
            nameCheckbox.onchange = () => handleUnknownCheckbox(i, 'Name');
            
            const nameCheckboxLabel = document.createElement('label');
            nameCheckboxLabel.className = 'checkbox-label';
            nameCheckboxLabel.textContent = 'U/K';
            nameCheckboxLabel.setAttribute('for', `childNameUnknown${i}`);
            
            nameFieldContainer.appendChild(nameInput);
            nameFieldContainer.appendChild(nameCheckbox);
            nameFieldContainer.appendChild(nameCheckboxLabel);
            nameWrapper.appendChild(nameFieldContainer);
            
            // Age field with checkbox
            const ageWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            ageWrapper.className = 'child-field-wrapper age-field';
            
            const ageLabel = document.createElement('label');
            ageLabel.className = 'child-label';
            ageLabel.textContent = 'Age:';
            ageWrapper.appendChild(ageLabel);
            
            const ageFieldContainer = document.createElement('div');
            ageFieldContainer.className = 'field-with-checkbox';
            
            const ageInput = document.createElement('input');
            ageInput.type = 'number';
            ageInput.id = `childAge${i}`;
            ageInput.name = `Child ${i} Age`;
            ageInput.placeholder = 'Age';
            ageInput.min = '0';
            ageInput.max = '18';
            ageInput.required = true;
            
            const ageCheckbox = document.createElement('input');
            ageCheckbox.type = 'checkbox';
            ageCheckbox.id = `childAgeUnknown${i}`;
            ageCheckbox.onchange = () => handleUnknownCheckbox(i, 'Age');
            
            const ageCheckboxLabel = document.createElement('label');
            ageCheckboxLabel.className = 'checkbox-label';
            ageCheckboxLabel.textContent = 'U/K';
            ageCheckboxLabel.setAttribute('for', `childAgeUnknown${i}`);
            
            ageFieldContainer.appendChild(ageInput);
            ageFieldContainer.appendChild(ageCheckbox);
            ageFieldContainer.appendChild(ageCheckboxLabel);
            ageWrapper.appendChild(ageFieldContainer);
            
            // Ethnicity field with checkbox
            const ethnicityWrapper = document.createElement('div');
            ethnicityWrapper.className = 'child-field-wrapper';
            
            const ethnicityLabel = document.createElement('label');

function updateSchoolLabel(childNumber) {
    const nameInput = document.getElementById(`childName${childNumber}`);
    const schoolLabel = document.getElementById(`schoolLabel${childNumber}`);
    const schoolInput = document.getElementById(`childSchool${childNumber}`);

            if (schoolInput) {
                schoolInput.name = `Child ${childNumber} School/Place of Education`;
            }
        }
    }
}

function updateChildText(isMultiple) {
    const childTextElements = document.querySelectorAll('.child-text');
    childTextElements.forEach(element => {
        const currentText = element.textContent;
        if (isMultiple) {
            if (currentText === 'child') {
                element.textContent = 'children';
            } else if (currentText === 'child/children') {
                element.textContent = 'children';
            }
        } else {
            if (currentText === 'children') {
                element.textContent = 'child';
            } else if (currentText === 'child/children') {

function copyThriveOnly() {
    const form = document.getElementById('combinedThriveForm');
    
    const thriveRequiredFields = [
        document.getElementById('thriveLevel'),
        document.getElementById('thriveR'),
        document.getElementById('thriveH'),
        document.getElementById('thriveRiskCopy'),

        document.getElementById('thriveEndStatementText'),
        document.getElementById('thriveVulnerability'),
        document.getElementById('thriveEngagement'),
        document.getElementById('childAtRisk')
    ];
    
    let missingFields = [];
    
    thriveRequiredFields.forEach(field => {
        if (!field.value.trim()) {
            let labelText = '';
            if (field.id) {
                const label = form.querySelector(`label[for="${field.id}"]`);
                if (label) {
                    labelText = label.textContent.replace(':', '').trim();
                    if (labelText === "Thrive - ") labelText = "Thrive Level";
                    if (labelText === "End Statement") labelText = "End Statement Details";
                }
            }
            if (!labelText && field.name) labelText = field.name;
            missingFields.push(labelText || 'Unknown field');
        }
    });

    if (missingFields.length > 0) {
        alert('Please fill in the following THRIVE required fields:\n\n- ' + missingFields.join('\n- '));
        const firstMissingField = thriveRequiredFields.find(field => !field.value.trim());
        if (firstMissingField) firstMissingField.focus();
        return;
    }

    const rethriveCheckbox = document.getElementById('rethriveCheckbox');
    const isRethrive = rethriveCheckbox && rethriveCheckbox.checked;
    
    const thriveData = {
        thriveLevel: form['Thrive - '].value,

        H: form.thriveH.value,

        I: form.thriveInvestigation.value,
        endStatement: form.thriveEndStatementText.value,

        E: form.thriveEngagement.value,
        childAtRisk: form.childAtRisk.value,
        isRethrive: isRethrive
    };

    let childAtRiskWithRef = thriveData.childAtRisk;
    if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Yes G15004011';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'No') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'No G15004022';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Unable to establish') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Unable to establish if a child is at risk: Ref G15004055';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Not required grade 1') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Not required as Incident is a grade 1: Ref G15004066';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Rethrive - Forms already Completed') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Rethrive - Forms already Completed: Ref G15004077';
    }

    const thrivePrefix = thriveData.isRethrive ? 'ReThrive' : 'Thrive';
    
    const textToCopy = `
${thrivePrefix}: ${thriveData.thriveLevel}

T: ${thriveData.T}

H: ${thriveData.H}

R: ${thriveData.thriveLevel} Risk - ${thriveData.R}

I: ${thriveData.I}

Is There A Child At Risk: ${childAtRiskWithRef}

THRIVE Form : Started: ${getThriveStartTime() || 'Not recorded'} Completed: ${getThriveEndTime() || 'Not recorded'}
`.trim();

    textarea.value = textToCopy;
    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    textarea.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(textarea);

    showCopySuccess('THRIVE Report copied to clipboard!');
    
    const formContainer = document.querySelector('.form-container');
    if (formContainer.classList.contains('child-at-risk-section-locked')) {
        setTimeout(() => {

function updateFieldStyles() {
    document.querySelectorAll('textarea, select, input[type="text"], input[type="number"]').forEach(field => {
        // Remove existing listeners to avoid duplicates
        field.removeEventListener('input', handleFieldChange);
        field.removeEventListener('change', handleFieldChange);
        // Add the listeners
        field.addEventListener('input', handleFieldChange);
        field.addEventListener('change', handleFieldChange);
    });
    
    // Add multiple event listeners for the engagement field to end the timer
    const engagementField = document.getElementById('thriveEngagement');
    if (engagementField && !engagementField.hasAttribute('data-timer-listener')) {
        // End timer on blur (tab out)
        engagementField.addEventListener('blur', function() {
            checkThriveEnd();
        });
        
        // End timer on input (when user types in the field)
        engagementField.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '' && thriveStartTime && !thriveEndTime) {
                checkThriveEnd();
            }
        });
        
        // End timer when engagement field gets content from checkboxes
        engagementField.addEventListener('change', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '' && thriveStartTime && !thriveEndTime) {
                checkThriveEnd();
            }
        });
        
        engagementField.setAttribute('data-timer-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    // Add specific styling handlers for combo fields that don't use checkboxes
    const vulnerabilityField = document.getElementById('thriveVulnerability');
    const endStatementField = document.getElementById('thriveEndStatementText');
    
    if (vulnerabilityField && !vulnerabilityField.hasAttribute('data-combo-listener')) {
        vulnerabilityField.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '') {
                applyCompletedStyle(this);
            } else {
                applyIncompleteStyle(this);
            }
        });
        vulnerabilityField.setAttribute('data-combo-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    if (endStatementField && !endStatementField.hasAttribute('data-combo-listener')) {
        endStatementField.addEventListener('input', function() {
            if (this.value.trim() !== '') {
                applyCompletedStyle(this);
            } else {
                applyIncompleteStyle(this);
            }
        });
        endStatementField.setAttribute('data-combo-listener', 'true');
    }
    
    // Add keyboard accessibility to H and E section headers
    const harmSectionHeader = document.getElementById('harmSectionHeader');
    const engagementSectionHeader = document.getElementById('engagementSectionHeader');
    
    if (harmSectionHeader && !harmSectionHeader.hasAttribute('data-keyboard-listener')) {
        harmSectionHeader.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                toggleHarmSection();
            }
        });
        harmSectionHeader.addEventListener('focus', function(e) {
            // Auto-expand when focused via keyboard
            const checkboxes = document.getElementById('thriveHCheckboxes');
            if (checkboxes.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                toggleHarmSection();
            }
        });

function handleFieldChange() {

        if (this.value.trim() !== '') {
            applyCompletedStyle(this);
        } else {
            applyIncompleteStyle(this);
        }
    }
    updateProgress();
}

function resetFormStyles() {
    document.querySelectorAll('textarea, select, input[type="text"], input[type="number"]').forEach(field => {
        applyIncompleteStyle(field);
    });
    document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('copyChildAtRiskBtn').style.display = 'none';
    updateProgress();
}

function validateAge(childNumber) {
    const ageInput = document.getElementById(`childAge${childNumber}`);
    const ageWarning = document.getElementById(`ageWarning${childNumber}`);
    
    if (ageInput && ageWarning) {
        const age = parseInt(ageInput.value);
        if (!isNaN(age) && age >= 18) {
            ageWarning.style.display = 'block';
            ageInput.style.borderColor = '#d32f2f';
            ageInput.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.1)';
        } else {
            ageWarning.style.display = 'none';
            if (ageInput.value.trim() !== '') {
                applyCompletedStyle(ageInput);
            } else {
                applyIncompleteStyle(ageInput);
            }
        }
    }
}

updateFieldStyles();
updateProgress();

window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    updateFieldStyles();
    updateProgress();
});

1. **Smart Case Detection**: When a user types in a text field and then moves to another field (on blur), the system analyzes the text to count uppercase vs lowercase letters.

- If someone types "Hello WORLD" → becomes "hello world" (majority lowercase)

<script>
let thriveStartTime = null;
let thriveEndTime = null;
let carStartTime = null;

function formatTimestamp() {
    return new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });
};

// Smart case conversion function
function smartCaseConversion(text) {
    if (!text || text.trim() === '') return text;
    
    // Count uppercase and lowercase letters
    let uppercaseCount = 0;
    let lowercaseCount = 0;
    
    for (let char of text) {
        if (char >= 'A' && char <= 'Z') {
            uppercaseCount++;
        } else if (char >= 'a' && char <= 'z') {
            lowercaseCount++;
        }
    }
    
    // If majority is uppercase, convert all to uppercase
    // If majority is lowercase, convert all to lowercase
    if (uppercaseCount > lowercaseCount) {
        return text.toUpperCase();
    } else if (lowercaseCount > uppercaseCount) {
        return text.toLowerCase();
    }
    
    // If equal or no letters, return as-is
    return text;
}

// Apply smart case conversion to form elements
function applyCaseConversion(element) {
    if (element.value) {
        element.value = smartCaseConversion(element.value);
    }
}

function getThriveStartTime() {
    return thriveStartTime;
}

function getThriveEndTime() {
    return thriveEndTime;
}

function getCarStartTime() {
    return carStartTime;
}

function checkThriveStart() {
    // Only start timing when the first question (THRIVE LEVEL) is answered
    const thriveLevel = document.getElementById('thriveLevel');
    if (!thriveStartTime && thriveLevel.value.trim() !== '') {
        thriveStartTime = formatTimestamp();
    }
}

function checkThriveEnd() {
    // End timing when user tabs out of E (Engagement) field
    // BUT only if the timer has actually started (thriveStartTime exists)
    if (!thriveEndTime && thriveStartTime) {
        thriveEndTime = formatTimestamp();
    }
}

function checkCarStart() {
    if (!carStartTime) {
        carStartTime = formatTimestamp();
    }
}

function applyCompletedStyle(element) {
    // Check if this is a checkbox container - if so, don't override display property
    if (element.classList.contains('checkbox-list')) {
        // For checkbox containers, only add the class and let CSS handle the styling
        element.classList.add('field-completed');
    } else {
        // For regular form fields, apply the styling with important
        element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #2e7d32', 'important');
        element.style.setProperty('background-color', 'rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.15)', 'important');
        element.classList.add('field-completed');
    }
}

function applyIncompleteStyle(element) {
    // Check if this is a checkbox container - if so, don't override display property
    if (element.classList.contains('checkbox-list')) {
        // For checkbox containers, only remove the class and let CSS handle the styling
        element.classList.remove('field-completed');
    } else {
        // For regular form fields, apply the styling with important
        if (element.classList.contains('child-at-risk-select') || element.id === 'thriveLevel' || element.id === 'childAtRisk') {
            element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #d32f2f', 'important');
        } else if (element.tagName === 'SELECT' && !element.classList.contains('child-at-risk-select')) {
            element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #2e7d32', 'important');
        } else {
            element.style.setProperty('border', '3px solid #d32f2f', 'important');
        }
        element.style.setProperty('background-color', '', 'important');
        element.classList.remove('field-completed');
    }
}

function addComboOption(select, targetTextareaId) {
    if (select.value) {
        const textarea = document.getElementById(targetTextareaId);
        if (textarea.value.trim().length > 0 && !textarea.value.trim().endsWith(',')) {
            textarea.value = textarea.value.trim() + ', ';
        }
        textarea.value += select.value;
        select.value = '';
        textarea.focus();
        
        // Use setTimeout to ensure styling is applied after any other event handlers
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (textarea.value.trim() !== '') {
                applyCompletedStyle(textarea);
            } else {
                applyIncompleteStyle(textarea);
            }
        }, 10);
    }
}

function handleOngoingRiskChange() {
    const ongoingRiskSelect = document.getElementById('childOngoingRisk');
    const ongoingRiskDetails = document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDetails');
    const ongoingRiskDescription = document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDescription');
    
    if (ongoingRiskSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        // Turn the select box red
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.border = '3px solid #d32f2f';
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(211, 47, 47, 0.2)';
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
        ongoingRiskSelect.style.color = '#d32f2f';
        
        // Show the additional text field
        ongoingRiskDetails.style.display = 'block';
        ongoingRiskDescription.setAttribute('required', 'true');
        ongoingRiskDescription.setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
    } else {
        // Reset the select box to normal completed style
        if (ongoingRiskSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
            applyCompletedStyle(ongoingRiskSelect);
        } else {
            applyIncompleteStyle(ongoingRiskSelect);
        }
        
        // Hide the additional text field
        ongoingRiskDetails.style.display = 'none';
        ongoingRiskDescription.removeAttribute('required');
        ongoingRiskDescription.setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        ongoingRiskDescription.value = '';
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function showPhilomenaInfo() {
    document.getElementById('philomenaModal').style.display = 'block';
}

function hidePhilomenaInfo() {
    document.getElementById('philomenaModal').style.display = 'none';
}

function handleChildPlanChange() {
    const childPlanSelect = document.getElementById('childPlan');

    if (childPlanSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        philomenaContainer.style.display = 'block';
        philomenaSelect.setAttribute('required', 'true');
        philomenaSelect.setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
    } else {
        philomenaContainer.style.display = 'none';
        philomenaSelect.removeAttribute('required');
        philomenaSelect.setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        philomenaSelect.value = '';
        document.getElementById('philomenaAdditionalInfo').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').value = '';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').removeAttribute('required');
    }
    
    if (childPlanSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
        applyCompletedStyle(childPlanSelect);
    } else {
        applyIncompleteStyle(childPlanSelect);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function handlePhilomenaChange() {
    const philomenaSelect = document.getElementById('philomenaProtocol');
    const additionalInfo = document.getElementById('philomenaAdditionalInfo');
    
    if (philomenaSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        additionalInfo.style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').setAttribute('required', 'true');
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
    } else {
        additionalInfo.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').removeAttribute('required');
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        document.getElementById('philomenaDetails').value = '';
    }
    
    if (philomenaSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
        applyCompletedStyle(philomenaSelect);
    } else {
        applyIncompleteStyle(philomenaSelect);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

// Close modal when clicking outside of it
window.onclick = function(event) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('philomenaModal');
    if (event.target == modal) {
        modal.style.display = 'none';

function lockThriveSection() {
    const thriveFields = document.querySelector('.thrive-fields');
    thriveFields.classList.add('locked');
    
    thriveFields.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(field => {
        field.disabled = true;
    });
    
    const thriveCopyBtn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="copyThriveOnly()"]');
    if (thriveCopyBtn) {
        thriveCopyBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
    
    const clearBtn = document.querySelector('.clear-button');
    if (clearBtn) {
        clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
    }
    
    const childAtRiskBtn = document.getElementById('copyChildAtRiskBtn');
    if (childAtRiskBtn && document.getElementById('childAtRisk').value === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'block';
    }
}

function lockChildAtRiskSection() {
    const formContainer = document.querySelector('.form-container');
    formContainer.classList.add('child-at-risk-section-locked');
    
    const childAtRiskSection = document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection');
    childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(field => {
        field.disabled = true;
    });
    
    const childAtRiskBtn = document.getElementById('copyChildAtRiskBtn');
    if (childAtRiskBtn) {
        childAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }
    
    const thriveFields = document.querySelector('.thrive-fields');
    if (!thriveFields.classList.contains('locked')) {
        const thriveCopyBtn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="copyThriveOnly()"]');
        if (thriveCopyBtn) {
            thriveCopyBtn.style.display = 'block';
        }
    }
}

function lockForm() {
    const thriveFields = document.querySelector('.thrive-fields');
    if (thriveFields) {
        thriveFields.classList.remove('locked');
    }
    
    const formContainer = document.querySelector('.form-container');
    formContainer.classList.add('form-locked');
    
    // Add locked message with animation
    const lockedMessage = document.createElement('div');
    lockedMessage.className = 'locked-message';
    lockedMessage.innerHTML = '⚠️ FORM LOCKED ⚠️<br><span style="font-size: 16px;">All reports have been copied</span>';
    formContainer.appendChild(lockedMessage);
    
    // Make top new report button more prominent
    const topNewReport = document.querySelector('.top-new-report');
    if (topNewReport) {
        topNewReport.classList.add('locked');
    }
    
    document.querySelector('.button-container').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(btn => {
        if (!btn.classList.contains('new-report-button')) {
            btn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    });
    
    const newReportBtn = document.getElementById('newReportBtn');
    newReportBtn.style.display = 'block';
    newReportBtn.classList.add('pulse');
    
    const form = document.getElementById('combinedThriveForm');
    form.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').forEach(field => {
        field.disabled = true;
    });

function startNewReport() {
    if (confirm('Are you sure you want to start a new report? This will clear all current data.')) {
        // Reset timestamp variables
        thriveStartTime = null;
        thriveEndTime = null;
        carStartTime = null;
        window.location.reload();
    }
}

function showCopySuccess(message) {
    const existingSuccess = document.querySelector('.copy-success');
    if (existingSuccess) {
        existingSuccess.remove();
    }
    
    const successDiv = document.createElement('div');
    successDiv.className = 'copy-success';
    successDiv.textContent = message;
    document.body.appendChild(successDiv);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        successDiv.style.animation = 'fadeOut 0.5s ease-out';
        setTimeout(() => {
            successDiv.remove();
        }, 500);
    }, 3000);
}

function clearForm() {
    if (confirm('Are you sure you want to clear all form data?')) {
        const form = document.getElementById('combinedThriveForm');
        form.reset();
        resetFormStyles();
        updateProgress();
        // Reset timestamp variables
        thriveStartTime = null;
        thriveEndTime = null;
        carStartTime = null;
        window.location.reload();
    }
}

function updateProgress() {
    const thriveFields = [
        document.getElementById('thriveLevel'),
        document.getElementById('thriveR'),
        document.getElementById('thriveH'),
        document.getElementById('thriveRiskCopy'),
        document.getElementById('thriveInvestigation'),
        document.getElementById('thriveEndStatementText'),
        document.getElementById('thriveVulnerability'),
        document.getElementById('thriveEngagement'),
        document.getElementById('childAtRisk')
    ];
    
    const thriveComplete = thriveFields.every(field => field && field.value.trim() !== '');
    const thriveProgress = document.getElementById('thriveProgress');
    
    if (thriveComplete) {
        thriveProgress.className = 'progress-complete';
        thriveProgress.textContent = '✓ THRIVE section complete';
    } else {
        thriveProgress.className = 'progress-incomplete';
        thriveProgress.textContent = '✗ THRIVE section incomplete';
    }
    
    const childAtRiskValue = document.getElementById('childAtRisk').value;
    const childAtRiskProgress = document.getElementById('childAtRiskProgress');
    
    if (childAtRiskValue === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskProgress.style.display = 'block';
        const childAtRiskSection = document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection');
        const childFields = childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('[required], [data-required="true"]');
        const childComplete = Array.from(childFields).every(field => field.value.trim() !== '');
        
        if (childComplete) {
            childAtRiskProgress.className = 'progress-complete';
            childAtRiskProgress.textContent = '✓ Child at Risk section complete';
        } else {
            childAtRiskProgress.className = 'progress-incomplete';
            childAtRiskProgress.textContent = '✗ Child at Risk section incomplete';
        }
    } else {
        childAtRiskProgress.style.display = 'none';
    }
}

function handleChildAtRiskChange() {
    
    const childAtRiskSelect = document.getElementById('childAtRisk');
    const childAtRiskSection = document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection');
    const copyChildAtRiskBtn = document.getElementById('copyChildAtRiskBtn');
    
    if (childAtRiskSelect.value === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskSection.style.display = 'block';
        copyChildAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'block';
        childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(field => {
            if (field.hasAttribute('required') || field.id === 'philomenaProtocol' || field.id === 'childPlan') {
                field.setAttribute('data-required', 'true');
            }
        });
        // Reset child plan when CAR section is opened
        document.getElementById('childPlan').value = '';
        document.getElementById('philomenaContainer').style.display = 'none';
        // Reset ongoing risk fields
        document.getElementById('childOngoingRisk').value = '';
        document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDetails').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('ongoingRiskDescription').value = '';
    } else {
        childAtRiskSection.style.display = 'none';
        copyChildAtRiskBtn.style.display = 'none';
        childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea').forEach(field => {
            field.removeAttribute('required');
            field.setAttribute('data-required', 'false');
        });
    }
    
    if (childAtRiskSelect.value.trim() !== '') {
        applyCompletedStyle(childAtRiskSelect);
    } else {
        applyIncompleteStyle(childAtRiskSelect);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function handleSchoolUnknownCheckbox(schoolFieldId, checkboxId) {
    const checkbox = document.getElementById(checkboxId);
    const field = document.getElementById(schoolFieldId);
    
    if (checkbox.checked) {
        field.value = 'Unknown';
        field.removeAttribute('required');
        field.disabled = true;
        applyCompletedStyle(field);
    } else {
        field.value = '';
        field.required = true;
        field.disabled = false;
        applyIncompleteStyle(field);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

function handleUnknownCheckbox(childNumber, fieldType) {
    const checkbox = document.getElementById(`child${fieldType}Unknown${childNumber}`);
    const field = document.getElementById(`child${fieldType}${childNumber}`);
    
    if (checkbox.checked) {
        if (fieldType === 'Name') {
            field.value = 'Unknown';
        } else if (fieldType === 'Age') {
            field.value = '';
            field.placeholder = 'Unknown';
        } else if (fieldType === 'Ethnicity') {
            field.value = 'UN Unable to Provide';
        }
        
        field.removeAttribute('required');
        field.disabled = true;
        applyCompletedStyle(field);
    } else {
        if (fieldType === 'Age') {
            field.placeholder = 'Age';
        }
        field.value = '';
        field.required = true;
        field.disabled = false;
        applyIncompleteStyle(field);
    }
    
    updateProgress();
}

        updateChildText(false);

    }
    
    if (count) {

function updateSingleChildSchoolLabel() {
    const nameInput = document.getElementById('childName1');
    const schoolLabel = document.getElementById('singleChildSchoolLabel');
    const schoolInput = document.getElementById('childSchool');
    
    if (nameInput && schoolLabel && schoolInput) {
        const name = nameInput.value.trim();
        if (name && name !== 'Unknown') {
            schoolLabel.textContent = `Which school/place of education does ${name} attend?`;
            schoolInput.name = `Which school/place of education does ${name} attend?`;
        } else {
            schoolLabel.textContent = 'Which school/place of education does the child attend?';
            schoolInput.name = 'Which school/place of education does the child attend?';
        }
    }
}

function updateSchoolLabel(childNumber) {
    const nameInput = document.getElementById(`childName${childNumber}`);
    const schoolLabel = document.getElementById(`schoolLabel${childNumber}`);
    const schoolInput = document.getElementById(`childSchool${childNumber}`);
    
    if (nameInput && schoolLabel) {
        const name = nameInput.value.trim();
        if (name && name !== 'Unknown') {
            schoolLabel.textContent = `${name} School/Place of Education:`;
            if (schoolInput) {
                schoolInput.name = `${name} School/Place of Education`;
            }
        } else {
            schoolLabel.textContent = `Child ${childNumber} School/Place of Education:`;
            if (schoolInput) {
                schoolInput.name = `Child ${childNumber} School/Place of Education`;
            }
        }
    }
}

function updateChildText(isMultiple) {
    const childTextElements = document.querySelectorAll('.child-text');
    childTextElements.forEach(element => {
        const currentText = element.textContent;
        if (isMultiple) {
            if (currentText === 'child') {
                element.textContent = 'children';
            } else if (currentText === 'child/children') {
                element.textContent = 'children';
            }
        } else {
            if (currentText === 'children') {
                element.textContent = 'child';
            } else if (currentText === 'child/children') {
                element.textContent = 'child';
            }
        }
    });
    
    if (isMultiple) {
        document.getElementById('childOngoingRisk').name = 'Is there an ongoing risk to the children?';
        document.getElementById('childLocation').name = 'Location of children, or location last seen';
        document.getElementById('childInjuries').name = 'Are there any injuries to the children?';
        document.getElementById('childAdditionalNeeds').name = 'Do the children have any additional needs?';
        if (document.getElementById('childSchool')) {
            document.getElementById('childSchool').name = 'Which school/place of education do the children attend?';
        }
        document.getElementById('childRelationship').name = 'What relationship (if any) is informant to Children?';
        document.getElementById('childPlan').name = 'Are the children known to social services, on a Child Protection Plan, Child in Need or looked after children?';
        document.getElementById('childAuthority').name = 'Have the children been placed in Greater Manchester from another area?';
        document.getElementById('childOtherAdults').name = 'Any other adult, with caring responsibilities, who may reside with the children, permanently or occasionally (if applicable)';
        document.getElementById('philomenaProtocol').name = 'If the children are looked after children, is there a philomena protocol in place?';
    } else {
        document.getElementById('childOngoingRisk').name = 'Is there an ongoing risk to the child/children?';
        document.getElementById('childLocation').name = 'Location of child, or location last seen';
        document.getElementById('childInjuries').name = 'Are there any injuries to the child?';
        document.getElementById('childAdditionalNeeds').name = 'Does the child have any additional needs?';
        if (document.getElementById('childSchool')) {
            document.getElementById('childSchool').name = 'Which school/place of education does the child attend?';
        }
        document.getElementById('childRelationship').name = 'What relationship (if any) is informant to Child?';
        document.getElementById('childPlan').name = 'Is the child known to social services, on a Child Protection Plan, Child in Need or a looked after child?';
        document.getElementById('childAuthority').name = 'Has the child been placed in Greater Manchester from another area?';
        document.getElementById('childOtherAdults').name = 'Any other adult, with caring responsibilities, who may reside with the child, permanently or occasionally (if applicable)';
        document.getElementById('philomenaProtocol').name = 'If the child is a looked after child, is there a philomena protocol in place?';
    }
}

function copyThriveOnly() {
    const form = document.getElementById('combinedThriveForm');
    
    const thriveRequiredFields = [
        document.getElementById('thriveLevel'),
        document.getElementById('thriveR'),
        document.getElementById('thriveH'),
        document.getElementById('thriveRiskCopy'),
        document.getElementById('thriveInvestigation'),
        document.getElementById('thriveEndStatementText'),
        document.getElementById('thriveVulnerability'),
        document.getElementById('thriveEngagement'),
        document.getElementById('childAtRisk')
    ];
    
    let missingFields = [];
    
    thriveRequiredFields.forEach(field => {
        if (!field.value.trim()) {
            let labelText = '';
            if (field.id) {
                const label = form.querySelector(`label[for="${field.id}"]`);
                if (label) {
                    labelText = label.textContent.replace(':', '').trim();
                    if (labelText === "Thrive - ") labelText = "Thrive Level";
                    if (labelText === "End Statement") labelText = "End Statement Details";
                }
            }
            if (!labelText && field.name) labelText = field.name;
            missingFields.push(labelText || 'Unknown field');
        }
    });

    if (missingFields.length > 0) {
        alert('Please fill in the following THRIVE required fields:\n\n- ' + missingFields.join('\n- '));
        const firstMissingField = thriveRequiredFields.find(field => !field.value.trim());
        if (firstMissingField) firstMissingField.focus();
        return;
    }

    const rethriveCheckbox = document.getElementById('rethriveCheckbox');
    const isRethrive = rethriveCheckbox && rethriveCheckbox.checked;
    
    const thriveData = {
        thriveLevel: form['Thrive - '].value,
        T: form.thriveR.value,
        H: form.thriveH.value,
        R: form.thriveRiskCopy.value,
        I: form.thriveInvestigation.value,
        endStatement: form.thriveEndStatementText.value,
        V: form.thriveVulnerability.value,
        E: form.thriveEngagement.value,
        childAtRisk: form.childAtRisk.value,
        isRethrive: isRethrive
    };

    let childAtRiskWithRef = thriveData.childAtRisk;
    if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Yes') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Yes G15004011';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'No') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'No G15004022';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Unable to establish') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Unable to establish if a child is at risk: Ref G15004055';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Not required grade 1') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Not required as Incident is a grade 1: Ref G15004066';
    } else if (thriveData.childAtRisk === 'Rethrive - Forms already Completed') {
        childAtRiskWithRef = 'Rethrive - Forms already Completed: Ref G15004077';
    }

    const thrivePrefix = thriveData.isRethrive ? 'ReThrive' : 'Thrive';
    
    const textToCopy = `
${thrivePrefix}: ${thriveData.thriveLevel}

T: ${thriveData.T}

H: ${thriveData.H}

R: ${thriveData.thriveLevel} Risk - ${thriveData.R}

I: ${thriveData.I}

   End Statement: ${thriveData.endStatement}

V: ${thriveData.V}

E: ${thriveData.E}

Is There A Child At Risk: ${childAtRiskWithRef}

THRIVE Form : Started: ${getThriveStartTime() || 'Not recorded'} Completed: ${getThriveEndTime() || 'Not recorded'}
`.trim();

    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textarea.value = textToCopy;
    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    textarea.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(textarea);

    showCopySuccess('THRIVE Report copied to clipboard!');
    
    const formContainer = document.querySelector('.form-container');
    if (formContainer.classList.contains('child-at-risk-section-locked')) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            lockForm();
        }, 100);
    } else {
        setTimeout(() => {
            lockThriveSection();
        }, 100);
    }
}

function copyChildAtRiskOnly() {
    const form = document.getElementById('combinedThriveForm');
    
    const childAtRiskSection = document.getElementById('childAtRiskSection');
    const requiredFields = childAtRiskSection.querySelectorAll('[required], [data-required="true"]');
    
    let missingFields = [];
    
    requiredFields.forEach(field => {
        if (!field.value.trim()) {
            let labelText = '';
            if (field.id) {
                const label = form.querySelector(`label[for="${field.id}"]`);
                if (label) {
                    labelText = label.textContent.trim();
                }
            }
            if (!labelText && field.name) labelText = field.name;
            missingFields.push(labelText || 'Unknown field');
        }
    });

    if (missingFields.length > 0) {
        alert('Please fill in the following Child at Risk required fields:\n\n- ' + missingFields.join('\n- '));
        const firstMissingField = Array.from(requiredFields).find(field => !field.value.trim());
        if (firstMissingField) firstMissingField.focus();
        return;
    }

    let textToCopy = `******* Child at Risk Report - G15004003 *******\n\n`;
    
    const formData = new FormData(form);
    const entries = Array.from(formData.entries());
    const childrenCount = document.getElementById('childrenCount').value;
    
    // Add children details FIRST (second item after header)
    if (childrenCount > 0) {
        textToCopy += `Children Details:\n`;
        for (let i = 1; i <= childrenCount; i++) {
            let name, age, ethnicity;
            
            // Check individual unknown checkboxes
            const nameUnknown = document.getElementById(`childNameUnknown${i}`);
            const ageUnknown = document.getElementById(`childAgeUnknown${i}`);
            const ethnicityUnknown = document.getElementById(`childEthnicityUnknown${i}`);
            const schoolUnknown = document.getElementById(`childSchool${i}Unknown`) || document.getElementById('childSchoolUnknown');
            
            if (nameUnknown && nameUnknown.checked) {
                name = 'Unknown';
            } else {
                name = document.getElementById(`childName${i}`).value || 'Unknown';
            }
            
            if (ageUnknown && ageUnknown.checked) {
                age = 'Unknown';
            } else {
                age = document.getElementById(`childAge${i}`).value || 'Unknown';
            }
            
            if (ethnicityUnknown && ethnicityUnknown.checked) {
                ethnicity = 'UN Unable to Provide';
            } else {
                ethnicity = document.getElementById(`childEthnicity${i}`).value || 'Unknown';
            }
            
            textToCopy += `Child ${i}: ${name}, Age ${age}, Ethnicity: ${ethnicity}\n`;
        }
        
        if (childrenCount > 1) {
            textToCopy += `\nSchool/Education Information:\n`;
            for (let i = 1; i <= childrenCount; i++) {
                const name = document.getElementById(`childName${i}`).value || `Child ${i}`;
                const schoolUnknown = document.getElementById(`childSchool${i}Unknown`);
                let school;
                if (schoolUnknown && schoolUnknown.checked) {
                    school = 'Unknown';
                } else {
                    school = document.getElementById(`childSchool${i}`).value;
                }
                textToCopy += `${name} School: ${school}\n`;
            }
        } else {
            const schoolUnknown = document.getElementById('childSchoolUnknown');
            let school;
            if (schoolUnknown && schoolUnknown.checked) {
                school = 'Unknown';
            } else {
                school = document.getElementById('childSchool').value;
            }
            textToCopy += `\nWhich school/place of education does the child attend?: ${school}\n`;
        }
        textToCopy += '\n';
    }
    
    const childAtRiskFields = [
        'Is there an ongoing risk to the child/children?',
        'Is there an ongoing risk to the children?',
        'What is the ongoing risk?',
        'How many children are at risk?',
        'What is the nature of the risk? (Abuse (Physical, Emotional, Sexual), Neglect, Exploitation, etc.)',
        'Location of child, or location last seen',
        'Location of children, or location last seen',
        'Are they in a safe place?',
        'Are there any injuries to the child?',
        'Are there any injuries to the children?',
        'Are there any concerns regarding medical conditions?',
        'Does the child have any additional needs?',
        'Do the children have any additional needs?',
        'Details of offender/s – location of offender/s if known',
        'Details of parental guardian/carers'
    ];
    
    entries.forEach(entry => {
        const fieldName = entry[0];
        const isChildNameOrAge = fieldName.includes('Child') && (fieldName.includes('Name') || fieldName.includes('Age'));
        const isSchoolField = fieldName.includes('School/Place of Education');
        
        if (childAtRiskFields.includes(fieldName) && !isChildNameOrAge && !isSchoolField) {
            textToCopy += `${entry[0]}: ${entry[1]}\n\n`;
        }
    });

    const remainingChildFields = [
        'What relationship (if any) is informant to Child?',
        'What relationship (if any) is informant to Children?',
        'Is the child known to social services, on a Child Protection Plan, Child in Need or a looked after child?',
        'Are the children known to social services, on a Child Protection Plan, Child in Need or looked after children?',
        'If the child is a looked after child, is there a philomena protocol in place?',
        'If the children are looked after children, is there a philomena protocol in place?',
        'Additional information about the philomena protocol',
        'Has the child been placed in Greater Manchester from another area?',
        'Have the children been placed in Greater Manchester from another area?',
        'Are there any further children who may also be at risk in relation to this report?',
        'Any other adult, with caring responsibilities, who may reside with the child, permanently or occasionally (if applicable)',
        'Any other adult, with caring responsibilities, who may reside with the children, permanently or occasionally (if applicable)'
    ];

    entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (remainingChildFields.includes(entry[0])) {
            textToCopy += `${entry[0]}: ${entry[1]}\n\n`;
        }
    });

    textToCopy = textToCopy.trim();

    
    textToCopy += `\n\nCAR Section Timing: Started: ${getCarStartTime() || 'Not recorded'} Completed: ${new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB', { 
    day: '2-digit', 
    month: '2-digit', 
    year: 'numeric', 
    hour: '2-digit', 
    minute: '2-digit', 
    second: '2-digit' 
})}`;

    const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textarea.value = textToCopy;
    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
